headline: Housing Board of Review heard two tenant-landlord hearings; one did not take place and one was closed for deliberation.
summary: The board held hearings for two cases. The hearing for 60 Colchester Avenue did not take place because the landlord did not attend and the tenant left. The hearing for 30 Chase Street was held, evidence was presented, and the board closed the hearing to deliberate in private.
plain_text:
BURLINGTON HOUSING BOARD OF REVIEW  
Monday, July 6, 2026 6:30 p.m.  
** REMOTE and IN PERSON**  
645 Pine Street, Front Conference Room OR  
Remotely via Zoom https://zoom.us/j/98216324779    
Minutes  
  
Board Members present: Joshua Wronski, Olivia Taylor, Don Slish, Emma Ramirez-Richer and Dylan 
Shelby 
Staff present: Shay Brunvand 
Meeting called to order at 06:32pm 
1. Dominic Brown (tenant); Macey Wiley (landlord) Re: 60 Colchester Avenue, Burlington, VT, 
Present was Dominic Brown 
The landlord did not attend, the hearing was postponed to see if the landlord would appear before 
the next hearing ended. The tenant left the hearing and did not return. The hearing did not take 
place.  
 
2. Nicholas Koleszar (tenant); Shandec Properties LLC c/o Full Circle Property Management 
(landlord) Re: 30 Chase Street, Burlington, VT.  
Present was Nicholas Koleszar, Michael Beaudette, Stephen Loreschel, Ed Adrian, Stephanie 
Gilbert and Morgan Loschiavo.  
Parties were sworn in. Both parties presented their evidence and testimony. The hearing was 
closed.  
 
The meeting was adjourned at 8:12pm 
 
The Board deliberated in private.
